headline: Motorola (MSI) & Telstra Enhance Tasmania's Public Safety
summary:
Motorola Solutions, Inc. MSI recently announced that it has joined forces with a leading telecommunications company — Telstra Corporation Limited TLSYY — to revamp the mission-critical communications infrastructure for emergency responders in Tasmania. As part of the multi-year agreement, the Tasmanian government will capitalize on Motorola’s broadband push-to-talk (PTT) services and Telstra’s expertise on radio systems for an enhanced public safety network across the Australian state.
